title: Critical thinking: questioning the source, the sample and the incentive

videos.script: Every number in a meeting arrives with a story about where it came from. Usually nobody tells that story. {{story}} Who measured it, and how? Who is it about, and who was left out? And who benefits if it says one thing rather than another? {{three}} Source, sample, incentive. Three questions that take a minute and catch most of what goes wrong with data before it reaches a decision. {{catch}} This lesson asks all three of Faro's numbers. The carrier's timestamp. The exit survey that says customers leave because of price. And the on-time rate that a carrier is paid a bonus on. {{faro}} Then it asks them of the hardest number to question. Your own. {{own}}
